summary: Clearmind Medicine filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release that welcomes and comments on a U.S. presidential executive order regarding psychedelic drug review processes. The release references the company's own clinical trials and prior legislative mentions, but the filing itself is purely a routine disclosure of a press release commenting on external regulatory developments. There is no transaction, acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, spin-off, activist campaign, strategic review, or other special-situation event being announced. The filing is an ordinary current report by a foreign private issuer.
